content: {"rules": ["Forecast models consistently overestimate prices in early cycles and underperform in late cycles.", "Sentiment peaks correlate with forecast overshoots, suggesting sentiment drives initial price spikes.", "Model bias toward upward trends persists despite true price mean-reversion signals.", "Forecast lags in the first 5-7 days align with sentiment reversal patterns.", "True price drops often occur after forecast peaks, indicating model overconfidence in upward momentum.", "Sentiment negativity in the last 3-5 days precedes true price corrections, signaling model lag.", "Forecast accuracy improves when sentiment is stable and price trends are trending downward.", "Models fail to capture sharp reversals when sentiment shifts abruptly from positive to negative."]}
